**Title**: Hoka no Onna no Ko to H o Shiteiru Ore o Mite Koufun Suru Kanojo
**Original Title**: 他の女の子とHをしているオレを見て興奮する彼女
**Length**: Short (2 - 10 hours)
**Year**: Japan 2013-11-29, English Patch 2018-12-23
**Developer**: Material
**Publishers**: Material
**Language**: English
**Voice**: Japanese
**Translation**: [Washi Translation](https://washitranslation.wordpress.com/)

**Description**:
Kitamura Satoshi lives his happy university life with his girlfriend, Kawai Shiori. That is until one day she discovers a porn on his computer about a cheating wife.

Shiori confused by this runs away. After few days not talking to each other, she finally approaches Satoshi. Prepared for the worst, he thinks she is going to break up with him.

But she said something completely crazy: "H-have sex... in front of me... with another girl!"

And so their relationship complicates.

**Important**:

1. You need to change locale to Japanese.

2. No need to install.

**!!!** Remove folder RIO. This is an update for the original Japanese version that overwrites Misa's route translation.

とにかくクラシックにこだわりました。
マップは勿論、ドットキャラクター、カニ歩き、戦闘、音楽、メッセージなど。

冒険の途中で様々なイベントが発生します。

title: HentaiHaven Archive
description:
After seeing the thread about https://reddit.com/u/jacko12127 which archived all the content of HentaiHaven and uploaded it to GDrive, I saw a lot of comments, which said they couldn't download the content to GDrive because there is a bandwidth limit and that, in a few days, GDrive will be deleted by Google for not respecting the TOS.


So a friend (https://www.reddit.com/user/Kiruu_) and I decided to upload it to our server, and create a torrent. The torrent is seeded on our server, so no problem on it, and we count on you to seed such an amazing collection!

Thanks again to https://reddit.com/u/jacko12127 for archiving and uploading all this cool stuff!
